newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canada's Nova Scotia launches 5.5% dual samurai.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Nova Scotia launches 5.5% dual samurai.

text.p: Canada's province of Nova Scotia on Tuesday launched 25 billion yen worth of 5.5 percent yen/Australian dollar dual currency samurai bonds due on May 12, 1999, lead manager Nikko Securities said.
The bonds are priced at par, with semi-annual coupon payments.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive A$5,638.89 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows:
AMT 25 bln yen COUPON 5.5% MATURITY May 12, 1999
TYPE yen/A$ samurai ISS PRICE 100 yen PAY DATE Oct 30, 1996
